fixtures.label: Every open receivable, aged by due date
fixtures.description: The PRIMARY document — the whole receivable book on the route's default anchor (`due_date`, the one the live Xero tenant ages by), and the only fixture whose Account column spans UNRELATED customers. Captured 2026-09-08 over all 28 open receivables, grouping to 14 accounts. Three jobs. (1) THE UNTRIMMED CHAIN. `statement.eta` trims each line's chain against its own scope; this family prints the whole chain on every row, and an `all` run is where that matters most — no common prefix to trim against and no addressee to have already named it. Censused 2026-09-07 over all 318 prod orgs, the 29 department nodes carry 8 distinct names, 24 of them sharing `Locations`, `Office` and `Transpo`; on this very population two accounts are both a `Locations`, separated only by the levels a leaf segment discards. That is api-cloudrun#923. (2) THE `all` SCOPE LINE — `scope.kind === "all"` prints "Every open receivable" and `scope.name` is `""`, the arm neither sibling reaches. (3) A NOT-YET-DUE ROW — invoice 2386 is dated forward (due 2026-10-02 against an as-of of 2026-09-08), so it lands in `current` with a NEGATIVE days-overdue. That is the case behind one of the two defects only the rendered page caught: a right-aligned Days column ran into the Bucket beside it and printed `-17Current` as one number. ⚠️ 31-60, 61-90 and 90+ read $0.00 on EVERY fixture in this family — nothing in the book is that old. Only an `all:-:date` run reaches 31-60 today ($1,213.00 across invoices 2343/2363/2364/2371); a bucket column is a value, not a branch, so that was not judged worth a fourth capture. 🔴 The masked names in the matrix and the detail DISAGREE for the same account — 18 uids here — because `applyPii` seeds on field path. That is core#91, not a render bug; re-capture when it lands. ⚠️ `buildAgingReport` refuses any as-of but today's, so a re-capture renders different money BY CONSTRUCTION, not by drift.

fixtures.label: Scoped to a subtree, aged by invoice date
fixtures.description: The only SCOPED run, the only "and N sub-accounts" sentence, and the only fixture on the `date` anchor — three arms `all-accounts` cannot reach. `organization-subtree` on Netflix Productions, LLC, the widest prod org family at 14 nodes (the root behind the statement family's `balance-forward-subtree`), captured 2026-09-08. (1) THE SCOPE LINE'S OTHER ARM. `scope.kind === "organization"` prints `scope.name` and, because `uids.length` is 14, appends "and 13 sub-accounts" — the plural branch of a sentence that is singular at 2 and absent at 1. `nothing-outstanding` holds the absent arm. (2) THE ANCHOR, AND IT IS NOT COSMETIC — measured on this fixture's own three invoices, not asserted. Aged by `date` the page reads current $1,135.57 / 1-30 $1,514.95; aged by `due_date` all three fall due after the as-of and the whole $2,650.52 is `current`. One account is either wholly current or more than half overdue depending on which stored date you age from — which is why the document states which it used, and why `anchorText` prints "Invoice date" here against "Due date" on both siblings. (⭐ That $1,514.95 is invoices 2402 + 2403, the same figure `balance-forward-subtree` ties to the live Xero tenant, reached through a different fold.) (3) TWO ACCOUNTS SHARING A PREFIX — Big Red / Office and Big Red / Locations, so the untrimmed chain is exercised exactly where `statement.eta` would have trimmed it away. ⚠️ Deliberately SMALL — 3 invoices — so the anchor is the only thing worth looking at in the diff. 🔴 EXPECT THE TWO TABLES TO NAME THE SAME ACCOUNTS DIFFERENTLY: that is core#91, not a render bug. `applyPii` seeds on FIELD PATH, so uid `gql6…` is `Wayfarer` in the matrix and `Copperline` in the detail; and `scope.name` masks as `text`, hence `Sample text for name....`. Re-capture when core#91 lands. ⚠️ `buildAgingReport` refuses any as-of but today's, so a re-capture renders different money BY CONSTRUCTION.

fixtures.label: An account that owes nothing — the empty book
fixtures.description: The EMPTY BOOK — the only fixture that renders neither table, and the only one whose scope sentence has no sub-account clause. `organization` (not `-subtree`) on 20th Television / Deli Boys S2 / Office, a department with a long settled invoice history and nothing open, captured 2026-09-08. Two jobs, and neither sibling can do either. (1) EVERYTHING IS PAID IS A REAL AND GOOD CASE. With `organizations` empty and the residual zero, the account matrix is replaced by a sentence and the detail table is dropped — the same choice `statement.eta` makes with `#no-activity`, because a headed table with no rows under it reads as a fault rather than as an answer. Without this fixture that whole arm is frozen by no golden and a green run says nothing about it, which is the failure mode this family's own `templates#256` note is about. (2) THE SINGULAR SCOPE. `scope.uids.length === 1`, so `scopeText` is the account name ALONE — no "and N sub-accounts". Its sibling `subtree-invoice-date` renders the plural arm at 14 nodes; the two are a pair and neither substitutes, because the clause is appended by a conditional that a single-node scope must not fire. ⭐ Deliberately a real settled account rather than a fabricated empty one: a report scoped to a customer who owes nothing is what someone chasing money actually runs, and a capture of it costs nothing. ⚠️ It is the smallest fixture in the family by a wide margin, which is the point — the page it freezes is a letterhead, a scope line and one sentence.
